test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) He will come / (B) and receive you / (C) at the station / (D) when you will arrive.
solution:
The correct answer is 'D' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the future tense 'will arrive' is incorrect.
 
• When referring to future events that are certain, the **present simple tense** is used after time conjunctions like** 'when'**, 'after', 'before', 'as soon as', etc.
 
 
• Example: We will go out for dinner after he finishes his work.
 
 
 
• The correct form should be 'arrive' since the sentence is talking about a future event that is certain.
 
• Hence, the correct part should be 'when you arrive.'

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *He will come and receive you at the station when you **arrive***.
